summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js` at the package root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line JavaScript file using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` decoder, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers) whose content is unrelated to the package's advertised Verdaccio Okta OAuth purpose and is not referenced from `dist/` or `src/`. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute code that would not run under a Node-only static analysis path. Additionally, the `files` allowlist in package.json declares only `["bin", "dist", "src"]`, yet both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped at the tarball root outside that allowlist. The combination — install-time fetch of a second runtime, obfuscated opaque payload executed under that runtime, payload smuggled outside the declared file manifest, and no relationship to the package's stated OAuth functionality — matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
